_note: Travel type test v1 questions. Stats: SOC sociability (Big Five extraversion), EXP exploration (openness / Plog allocentric), SEN sensibility (openness-aesthetics), ACT activity (sensation seeking), PLN planning (conscientiousness), CRW crowd tolerance (sensory sensitivity, reversed). Weights are -2..+2 per option; each stat maps its random-answer mean to 50 (see src/lib/travelType.ts). zh-tw is generated by scripts/gen-travel-type-zh-tw.mjs.
